# clavis admin reset-password

<p class="cli-lead">Print a one-time password reset link for a user (no email needed)</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis admin reset-password EMAIL [flags]
```

</div>

Print a one-time link that sets a new password for a user. Use it when
someone, including the only owner, is locked out and the server has no
email (SMTP) configured. The link is valid for 24 hours by default and
the reset is recorded in the audit log.

## Examples

<p class="cli-example-title">Docker</p>

```sh
docker exec clavis clavis admin reset-password you@example.com
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Valid for one hour</p>

```sh
clavis admin reset-password ada@example.com --valid-for 1h
```

<dl class="cli-flags">

</dl>

## Details

Anyone with the link can set the password, so send it over a channel you trust.
